blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Tuesday served a subpoena to Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte, directing him to testify as a prosecution witness in the impeachment trial of his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte.
